crossRefs.note: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.
But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned…
because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.
translations.bsb: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all robust and valiant men. Not one of them escaped.
translations.kjv: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.
translations.asv: And they smote of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, every lusty man, and every man of valor; and there escaped not a man.
